name: ide-rust
author: lumine-code
description: Provide Rust language features with rust-analyzer.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to rust-analyzer. Leave empty to use the managed installation, then a working server on PATH.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Offer to install rust-analyzer when no working server can be found.

toolchain.title: Rust Toolchain
toolchain.description: Rustup toolchain such as stable or nightly. Leave empty to respect the project rust-toolchain.toml and your Rust environment.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which rust-analyzer features the editor uses. Code lenses require client commands that the editor does not yet execute; type hierarchy is not supplied by rust-analyzer.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report Rust analysis and Cargo check findings.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Complete names, fields, methods and imports.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show Rust types and documentation on hover.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show function parameters while entering arguments.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Navigate to declarations, definitions, types and implementations.

references.title: Find References
references.description: Find uses of a symbol across the project.

callHierarchy.title: Call Hierarchy
callHierarchy.description: Navigate between functions and their callers.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Apply fixes and refactorings supplied by rust-analyzer.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Show inferred types and parameter names inline.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Classify Rust symbols using semantic information.

checkOnSave.title: Check On Save
checkOnSave.description: Control Cargo checks after saving. Server Default preserves rust-analyzer's choice.

checkCommand.title: Check Command
checkCommand.description: Choose cargo check or cargo clippy for compiler and lint diagnostics. Server Default leaves the server configuration unchanged.

cargoFeatures.title: Cargo Features
cargoFeatures.description: Additional Cargo features to analyze. Leave empty to keep the server default.

allFeatures.title: All Cargo Features
allFeatures.description: Analyze every Cargo feature instead of the explicit Cargo Features list.

cargoTarget.title: Cargo Target
cargoTarget.description: Optional compilation target triple, such as wasm32-unknown-unknown. Leave empty for the project target.

allTargets.title: All Cargo Targets
allTargets.description: Include binaries, examples and tests in Cargo analysis. Server Default preserves rust-analyzer's choice.

buildScripts.title: Build Scripts
buildScripts.description: Run build.rs to discover generated code and configuration. Server Default preserves rust-analyzer's choice.

procMacros.title: Procedural Macros
procMacros.description: Expand procedural macros for analysis. Server Default preserves rust-analyzer's choice.

typeHints.title: Type Hints
typeHints.description: Control inline inferred type hints. Server Default preserves rust-analyzer's choice.

parameterHints.title: Parameter Hints
parameterHints.description: Control inline argument names. Server Default preserves rust-analyzer's choice.
